title: BudgetCompact
description: A *budget* object represents a budget for a given parent.

gid.description: Globally unique identifier of the resource, as a string.

resource_type.description: The base type of this resource.

budget_type.description: The type of the budget, in "cost" or "time". The value of this property will dictate how the corresponding values for actual, estimate, and total are interpreted.
